Rex grew up in a family of water well drillers and trained under Buster Enochs. By 1986, Rex had saved up enough money to finance a drilling rig and changed the name of the company to Bee Cave Drilling to reflect his expanded services.

Over the years, Bee Cave Drilling has been the leader in adopting new technologies and methods to improve the overall functioning of water well systems and to take ownership of a water well attainable for more people. Today Bee Cave Drilling is perhaps the busiest water well company in the Austin area with a fabulous staff of around 50 people and a growing number of satisfied customers. sources.title: Company Info - Bee Cave Drilling
paragraphs: In July of 1980, Bee Cave Drilling (then known as R&L Pump Service) began in the back room of Rex and Lois Bible’s house in Bee Cave, Texas. Rex grew up in a family of water well drillers and trained under Buster Enochs. By 1986, Rex had saved up enough money to finance a drilling rig and changed the name of the company to Bee Cave Drilling to reflect his expanded services.

The company remained a “mom and pop operation” with Rex in the field and Lois in the office with an occasional summer employee until 1993 when Jim Blair joined the staff full-time. Jim trained alongside Rex in the field drilling wells and servicing pumps. Along the way, Jim thought of new ways to improve what they were doing and Bee Cave Drilling became known amongst local home builders for both their superior systems and service. The company was able to grow and hire additional full-time staff. Jim took over management of the company in May of 1998 and became the owner in September of 2001. At that time Bee Cave Drilling moved to its present location northwest of Dripping Springs.

Over the years, Bee Cave Drilling has been the leader in adopting new technologies and methods to improve the overall functioning of water well systems and to take ownership of a water well attainable for more people. Today Bee Cave Drilling is perhaps the busiest water well company in the Austin area with a fabulous staff of around 50 people and a growing number of satisfied customers. We hope to be able to add you to that list. Check out our Services We Provide Menu to see what Bee Cave Drilling can do for you and our Testimonials Page to see what people think of our work.

sources.title: Staff Bios - Bee Cave Drilling
paragraphs: Jim is passionate about three things: God, his family, and water. He enjoys working with mission organizations around the world to bring drinking water to needy people. As a deacon in his church, Jim is involved in many ministry projects serving the local community. Jim and his family enjoy fishing, swimming, and hiking together. At work, Jim likes to take on new challenges. He will find a way to fix a well that is not functioning or get a pump out that other companies can’t. When someone says it can’t be done, Jim takes that as a challenge.

Jim Blair (Lic. 54416 CKMPW) is licensed by the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation as a Water Well Driller with designations in water wells, monitoring wells, and closed loop geothermal wells, and as a Pump Installer with designations in single phase and three phase pumps. Jim has been in the water well business since September of 1993.

Christy’s background is in media production where she produced talk shows in the radio industry, such as Point of View and Daybreak. An opportunity with SXSW brought her and her husband David to the Austin area. Christy and David have Biblical Counseling and Christian Education degrees, respectively. She is involved in her church and Christy’s passion is working with young ladies and helping them discover their purpose and calling. Christy is a certified Ministry Insights counselor.She also has a love for music which she continued to develop when she lived in Nashville, TN. Christy is always improving herself and making huge strides for the company here at Bee Cave Drilling. Her editing skills can be seen in our videos. Christy, David, their pug, Lemmy and their french bulldog Gismo, reside in Austin.

Greg is a true renaissance man. Like Jim, he knows the water well business forwards and backwards and is somewhat of a savant at remembering the details of every well he has drilled or worked on. He is also involved in a popular Czech polka band called The Czechaholics (www.czechaholics.com). (Click here for a video of Greg playing with his band). This keeps him busy most weekends playing dance halls, church picnics, and family reunions across the state. When not providing people water or playing with the band, Greg and his family enjoy fishing, swimming, and biking together. At work, Greg can design you a water well system to match your needs no matter how small or large or find a way to fix a well system that seems beyond hope.

Greg has been in the water well business since April of 2003.
